title: Electoral Commission: its table of party donations exceeding $20,000, and the $30,000 page under it

landmarks: one or more <table> elements whose every row has three cells
each table under a heading naming its regime: 'exceeding $20,000 since 1 January <year>', 'exceeding $30,000 from 1 January 2011', 'exceeding $20,000 from 2008'

signals_note: An HTML page, so recognition is by its structure: three-cell rows under a regime heading. The first row of each table is a header whose first cell begins 'Party,'.

over-20000-from-2023: party; date the Commission received the return; (the Commission's note)
amount, date the party received it; link to the scanned declaration
over-30000-2011-2022: party; declared total; date the Commission received it; (the Commission's note)
each gift and its date, one per line, as free text
over-20000-2008-2010: as 2011-2022; the amendment may be printed inline ('amended to $X', 'return amended from $Y - <date>')

notes: The Commission's own statement of every s 210C declaration (s 210C from 2023; earlier, the over-$30,000 and over-$20,000 regimes). The table is the source for the fields it carries (Arthur, 29 September 2026); the scanned declaration is the evidence and is cited beside it. A deterministic read: no model.
applies_to: elections.nz/democracy-in-nz/political-parties-in-new-zealand/donations-exceeding-20000/ and its donations-exceeding-30000 sub-page, as captured by the old ec-disclosures job.

tooling.index: the old estate's ec-disclosures job (headed browser, rulings 242/243)

process: One row is one declaration. From 2023 it is one gift; before, one donor's gifts that together passed the threshold, itemised as free text.

The bracketed note after the Commission's date is read, never inferred: 'amended return received <date>' and 'amended <date>' mean the row carries the amended figures; 'amendment withdrawn' means the original stands; anything else is kept verbatim as unread and acts on nothing.
The donor cell's lines after the first are an address and go to the private schema only.
gates: Every table row is a declaration or a catch-log line: rows seen equal rows read plus rows set aside.
A row whose figure does not exceed its regime's floor is the Commission's own figure; it is flagged, never dropped or changed.
on_fail: A row with no party, donor, amount or Commission date is set aside with the reason; it is never defaulted.
